note: A news report of the decentralisation consultation framework's session of 27 November 2025: it gives general commune finance (transfers under 2 per cent of the national budget; three funds of at most 3 billion CFA francs a year for 255 communes, per the Swiss cooperation head) and nothing on any commune office's connection, equipment or systems. The count of 255 communes is the only figure of use, as a denominator.
